name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US blockade of Iran; Graham Act in force
summary: US naval blockade of Iran in force; Iran makes its lifting a condition for Hormuz
state: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force; on 2 Nov Iran's foreign ministry said it must end before any agreement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran has set the lifting of sanctions and release of frozen funds as conditions in Doha talks. The Lindsey Graham Act, signed in October, expands secondary sanctions on Russia's trading partners.
for_you: Sanctions are reshaping energy trade routes and can affect prices and supply far from the targeted countries.
